scope: Read-only shortcut and published SDK review; no game launch or input injection
keyboardContract: Published SHV KeyboardHandler, register/unregister callbacks; no control consumption

references.use: Default F5-F8 character switches; avoid for arming
Maintained primary default-control reference; no backslash default assignment found; F9/F10 are weapon/ammo controls
Documented OEM virtual-key identifiers; layout-dependent key positions

limits: Inspected saved overrides are not a complete dump of every Enhanced built-in binding
No universal guarantee about third-party/global custom shortcuts or unusual keyboard layouts
Live preflight must recheck these exact settings fingerprints
No game bindings, modifier state or existing controls are consumed or rewritten by the probe
